title: IBD sharing within and between the sites associated with the Únětice and the Unterwölbling culture.
caption: The colours represent the two cultures: blue shades correspond to Unterwölbling, while orange shades correspond to Únětice. Different shades within each colour group indicate distinct sites within the respective culture. The thickness of the lines indicated values of max IBD in centimorgans (cM). Rectangles represent male individuals and ovals represent female individuals.
